The 'Enormous bony frill' checkpoint is failed as neither subject has a proper frill. No new artifacts were found by experts, but the expert silence on anatomy does not override the Router's visual findings of severe deformation.

The score is slightly above 0.0 only because the general 'dinosaur head' shape is recognizable, but it fails nearly all specific diagnostic checkpoints.
